name: What types of electrical fixtures can Frasheski Construction install?

mainEntity.name: What types of electrical fixtures can Frasheski Construction install?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction can install a wide range of electrical fixtures, including ceiling fans, recessed lighting, chandeliers, pendant lights, track lighting, outdoor security lights, and dimmers. We ensure proper wiring and secure mounting for all installations, whether for new constructions or upgrades. Our team handles both interior and exterior lighting needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Frasheski Construction installs various electrical fixtures such as ceiling fans, recessed lighting, chandeliers, and outdoor security lights.
